images.positive_prompt: Create one 1536x1536 square studio reference image of Milo. Visible cast: exactly one Milo; no other character. Milo is one slender young wool-felt mouse who walks upright on two legs. His body felt is warm taupe-brown (#8D624F, lighter on the crown #DBB09C) with looped bouclé texture and a soft halo of loose fibres on every outline. His round head is slightly wider at the cheeks, with a smooth felt crown and a fine dashed rust stitched seam from crown to nose. Two very large oval ears, each nearly as tall as the head is wide and tilted slightly outward, rise far above the crown: coral inner felt (#EF775F) inside a thick taupe-brown rim (#8F614E) with a rust stitched seam. Two short dark brown felt brows (#643426). Two large round glossy eyes, each about a fifth of the head width, centres under half a head width apart: dark brown irises (#723725), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4ECE8). A small rounded dark brown nose (#683629) under a soft peach bridge (#F9AC8C); two compact cream muzzle pads (#EFC5AD) with tiny brown dots; a wide mouth line; five long fine peach whiskers (#EEAE85) on each side. A narrow neck, slim torso and an elongated egg-shaped cream belly (#F8CEB4) with a centre seam, ending above the crotch, with a taupe-brown gap between two slim separated legs. Two slim arms with small curled paws; three rounded toes per foot. One long thin salmon tail (#BC735D), about half his height, attached at the lower back. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them, and the felt stays warm. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states. This is Milo's approved identity root: neutral front view, relaxed upright standing pose, arms resting at his sides, mouth closed in a soft neutral smile, looking at the camera, whole body centred with even margins. Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop, soft even neutral light and a small soft contact shadow under the feet; the whole body, ears, paws, mane where present and the single tail inside the frame with about 8% margin on every side. Light and colour: every character keeps exactly the colours, saturation and brightness of its canonical image; the scene light may only tint it the same way it tints the background, with the same exposure and contrast as the background. Characters are lit from the same direction as the plate and cast soft contact shadows on its ground, so they sit in the scene rather than on top of it. Style: handcrafted wool-felt stop-motion storybook miniature; softly stuffed matte forms, tactile looped wool fibres, fine visible stitching and gentle handmade irregularities; warm child-friendly palette and soft directional light; clear subject silhouettes; faces and contact points sharply readable. Before finishing, check: each visible character appears exactly once, with exactly two eyes and two eyebrows (one above each eye, drawn once), its canonical ears and limbs, whiskers on both sides of the muzzle and exactly one tail attached at its root; no text, letters, labels or watermark anywhere. Check every planted foot or paw against the frame's named walkable surface: it must rest on continuous ground at the correct depth, never on water, flower heads, a bush canopy or unsupported foliage. Confirm contact shadows and occlusion agree with the plate.

variants.full_prompt_specification: Milo lowers his head and turns to look along the safe left path. No character speaks in this piece. Keep each visible mouth exactly in its approved start/end pose; do not animate speech or mouth movement. The camera stays fixed in framing, crop and background scale for the whole clip. Milo is one slender young wool-felt mouse who walks upright on two legs. His body felt is warm taupe-brown (#8D624F, lighter on the crown #DBB09C) with looped bouclé texture and a soft halo of loose fibres on every outline. His round head is slightly wider at the cheeks, with a smooth felt crown and a fine dashed rust stitched seam from crown to nose. Two very large oval ears, each nearly as tall as the head is wide and tilted slightly outward, rise far above the crown: coral inner felt (#EF775F) inside a thick taupe-brown rim (#8F614E) with a rust stitched seam. Two short dark brown felt brows (#643426). Two large round glossy eyes, each about a fifth of the head width, centres under half a head width apart: dark brown irises (#723725), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4ECE8). A small rounded dark brown nose (#683629) under a soft peach bridge (#F9AC8C); two compact cream muzzle pads (#EFC5AD) with tiny brown dots; a wide mouth line; five long fine peach whiskers (#EEAE85) on each side. A narrow neck, slim torso and an elongated egg-shaped cream belly (#F8CEB4) with a centre seam, ending above the crotch, with a taupe-brown gap between two slim separated legs. Two slim arms with small curled paws; three rounded toes per foot. One long thin salmon tail (#BC735D), about half his height, attached at the lower back. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them, and the felt stays warm. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states. Start frame: Same position, body, paws and tail as before; Milo's head tilts up and his eyes look at the darkening sky above the trees; mouth closed. End frame: Milo at x=0.50,y=0.84 looking toward the safe left path; paws low, one tail settled. Ambient: Soft local leaf/grass-tip motion only; visible distant clouds drift slowly left-to-right. Trunks, roots, path and rocks remain fixed. A dirt path from the bottom centre splits around a mossy boulder: safe left branch curves up-left to a sunlit meadow (x 0.25-0.32, y 0.47); shortcut branch goes right (x 0.70-0.85, y 0.47-0.55) into darker trees. Horizon y 0.30-0.33. Walkable band y=0.55-1.00. Fixed landmarks: sun disc (0.185,0.255) on the left; big trunk x=0.63-0.70, y=0.00-0.47; mossy boulder centre (0.58,0.44); small rock below x=0.53-0.63, y=0.50-0.57; right-edge trunk x=0.95-1.00; berry clusters x=0.00-0.07, y=0.48-0.62 and x=0.85-0.98, y=0.73-0.86. Sunset from the left.
